Margot Robbie’s renovated Hollywood bungalow sold for $1.2 million
stories.summary: In February 2018, Margot Robbie bought a charming 945-square-foot bungalow in Hollywood Heights for $950,000. After giving it a stylish makeover, she rented it out at various rates. She eventually sold the property in 2021 for around $1.2 million, marking a profitable investment. This venture underscores the appeal of smaller homes in attractive neighborhoods, complementing her extensive property collection across Los Angeles and Australia.

stories.title: CJP's Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka withdraw plea challenging custody in Delhi HC
Meloni toughens protest laws: Teen detentions, parental liability, 5-year jail term
stories.summary: In response to recent disturbances, Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has introduced stringent security measures aimed at curbing protest-related violence. These measures entail prison sentences, fines, and even financial repercussions for parents of minors who participate in illegal protests. Authorities now have increased powers to detain youths perceived as threats, irrespective of actual criminal acts.

stories.title: Wetland restoration boosts Spain’s marbled ducks to 172 breeding females in 2025
Missouri court upholds revival of $220,000 judgment after appeal deadline is missed
stories.summary: Diane Longsdon encounters a significant legal hurdle as an appeals court dismisses her bid to contest a $220,000 repayment order. The issue originated from modifications to a family trust created by Violet M. Steinert and her spouse in 1994. Although Longsdon initially received money from these alterations, a court later upheld the original trust's validity.

stories.title: She revived her boyfriend twice after they were struck by lightning; a year later, they are married
stories.summary: During a hiking trip, Eva Broderick's quick thinking saved her boyfriend Nick's life after they were both struck by lightning. Stranded in an isolated area, they faced delays as rescuers searched for them without precise location data. After their recovery, Nick's heartfelt proposal led to their wedding nearly a year later in August. Eva's heroic actions highlight the life-saving potential of CPR knowledge in unpredictable outdoor situations.

stories.title: England rugby legend Lawrence Dallaglio’s World Cup medal sells for £54,000
stories.summary: An exciting auction spotlighted an array of sports memorabilia, notably sounding the sale of Lawrence Dallaglio's silver-gilt medal from the 2003 Rugby World Cup, fetching £54,000. Collectors clamored for not only this remarkable piece but also his British and Irish Lions cap. Further captivating bids were made on football items, including Eric Cantona's iconic shorts and a BBC World Cup table, showcasing the rising allure of sports collectibles.

stories.title: CMRL bribery case: SC stays probe against former Kerala CM Pinarayi Vijayan for a week
‘Term UN experts is oxymoron’: Rubio calls anti-EC protests ‘domestic political matter’
‘Get your facts straight’: BJP accuses Rahul Gandhi of hypocrisy over RSS remarks on women’s rights
stories.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party officials criticized Congress leader Rahul Gandhi for his recent statements about the RSS. They accused him of hypocrisy regarding women's respect based on his behavior towards women. BJP spokesperson CR Kesavan emphasized Gandhi's failure to address allegations against a Congress MP involved in harassment. Additionally, BJP MLA Ram Kadam challenged Gandhi's understanding of the RSS's women's wing.

stories.title: SC directs Andhra Pradesh poll panel to decide on extending nomination deadline by Thursday
'Damning photos': Opposition leaders question Hardeep Puri's alleged meeting with Jeffrey Epstein
stories.summary: Leaders from Congress, TMC, and NCP have voiced strong disapproval of Hardeep Singh Puri for his dealings with Jeffrey Epstein. Puri has contended that his interactions came during a professional delegation after his ambassadorial tenure. Critics are calling for clarification about the substance of these encounters, emphasizing their concerns over the ramifications of Puri's associations with someone linked to serious criminal charges.

stories.title: ‘Was it necessary?’ Anupam Kher slams Uttarakhand BJP minister over Daler Mehndi row
stories.summary: Anupam Kher expressed his disappointment with BJP's Uttarkhand minister Subodh Uniyal's treatment of singer Daler Mehndi on stage. During a cultural event, Uniyal called out Mehndi for allegedly lip-syncing and questioned his sobriety. Kher emphasised the importance of addressing concerns privately to maintain dignity and respect. Singer Mika Singh defended Mehndi, citing his health issues and denying alcohol consumption allegations.

stories.title: Kandinsky painting stolen by Nazis sells for $42M at auction
stories.summary: A painting by Wassily Kandinsky, titled Das bunte Leben, sold at auction for £31.56 million. This artwork was returned to the heirs of its original Jewish owners after decades of dispute. The piece was originally painted in 1907 and displayed at notable exhibitions. Following its theft by the Nazis, it changed hands multiple times before being held by a German bank.

stories.title: China’s vegetation restoration linked to groundwater drought from 2003 to 2015
stories.summary: Vegetation restoration on the Loess Plateau started in 1999, which caused a significant decline in groundwater storage levels. From 2003 to 2015, researchers observed rapid vegetation growth alongside worsening groundwater drought conditions. The decline in groundwater was statistically significant and affected a larger area with more severe drought. Satellite data provided insights into the relationship between vegetation growth and groundwater drought across the region.

stories.title: More trouble for CJP leaders: Another FIR against Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka transferred to Crime Branch
stories.summary: Delhi Police has transferred two FIRs against Cockroach Janta Party leaders to the Crime Branch for investigation. The leaders, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, were detained during protests at Connaught Place and Jantar Mantar. Legal challenges have been filed by their team to contest an extension of their judicial custody. They claim their continued detention violates their fundamental rights and due process.

stories.title: Queensland farmer reports cloudy well amid 96-million-litre water extraction plan
'Human rights shouldn't be used for political pressure': India amid UN criticism over handling of protests
After HM visit CBI team begins investigations into killing of anti-drug activist, CBI registers FIR
stories.summary: A team from the Central Bureau of Investigations arrived in Mansa to investigate the murder of Parwinder Singh Jhota. The investigation was prompted by demands from Jhota's father and a local action committee for justice. Union Home Minister Amit Shah visited the bereaved family and assured them of justice before the CBI's arrival. The CBI is expected to collect evidence pertinent to the case and conduct a thorough investigation.

stories.title: Dev Rai founded a nonprofit at 15; it has helped 400 artisans, sold 900 products and mobilised 300 volunteers
stories.summary: At just 15 years old, Dev Rai launched Serving Society Global Foundation, aiming to uplift India's traditional artisans. This growing nonprofit has generated over $15,000 and engaged more than 300 volunteers. By creating essential connections between artisans and American consumers through community initiatives, Rai envisions a future where these artisans can thrive through digital platforms, enhancing cultural heritage while empowering youth in entrepreneurship and leadership roles.

stories.title: Olivia Wilde sells Studio City home for $5.23M, nearly $700K below 2023 price
Quote of the day by Stephen Hawking: “We are just an advanced breed of monkeys on..."
Pete Davidson sells Staten Island condo at a $400,000 loss after listing in 2026
stories.summary: Pete Davidson sold his Staten Island condominium for $800,000, taking a substantial loss on the property. He had previously purchased the condo for $1.2 million and completed renovations after acquiring it. Davidson also struggles to sell his North Salem estate, which has undergone multiple price reductions since being listed. The estate features amenities such as a gourmet kitchen and a gaming room, appealing to potential buyers.

stories.title: Who is next Republican nominee for US Prez? Vance expects endorsement; Trump says 'no'
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump has declined to endorse Vice President JD Vance for the 2028 presidential election. While Vance expects Trump's support if he runs, Trump did not commit to backing him. Trump stated there are many capable individuals who could succeed him in the future. Vance acknowledged he hadn't discussed his candidacy directly with Trump. Both their remarks highlight the uncertain nature of the upcoming Republican nomination contest.

stories.title: When superheroes hit the streets: Batman, Spider-Man & Cap.America at France protests - watch
stories.summary: Recent protests in France saw participants dressed as superheroes like Captain America, Batman, and Spider-Man. While demonstrations began with student grievances, they broadened to include various groups united against rising living costs. In cities like Marseille and Paris, clashes with police erupted, where costumed figures captured attention amid the unrest. Additionally, historical figures such as Napoleon were also spotted among demonstrators.

stories.title: 'My journey began with Ramleela': Ravi Kishan portrays Lord Ram during Dussehra celebrations in Delhi
Jhota murder case: CBI takes over Punjab anti-drug activist killing case, files fresh FIR
stories.summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation has registered a case regarding the murder of Parvinder Singh Jhota. Jhota was shot dead inside a medical store in Punjab's Mansa while hosting a Facebook Live session. Following demands from his family, Chief Minister Bhagwant Singh Mann announced the case's transfer to the CBI. Union Home Minister Amit Shah welcomed this decision but criticized the state government for not addressing other drug-related cases.

stories.title: A newly built Nando’s drive-through in Australia sold for $5.845 million
stories.summary: A newly built Nando's drive-through site in Cranbourne North has been acquired for $5.845 million by a New South Wales investor. The development includes a dual-lane drive-through facility and is secured by a long-term lease with Nando's Australia, ensuring an anticipated annual net income of $319,035, alongside fixed rent hikes of 3%. The transaction indicates a rising trend in commercial property investments in Victoria, particularly from out-of-state buyers.

stories.title: 'Quiet, quiet, are you a sick person?' Trumps snaps at reporter at White House; watch
Jonathan Spano’s eyesight ended his Navy dream; he flew for ‘Top Gun: Maverick’
Falling water levels at Utah’s Great Salt Lake exposed mysterious circular mounds
stories.summary: Newly released satellite images reveal an array of circular mounds at Great Salt Lake, predominantly formed by freshwater springs, which significantly contribute 12% to the lake’s water levels. Researchers, during expeditions across the receding lakebed, confirmed this essential finding. The unique circular reeds at the mound centers highlight the presence of these freshwater sources, which could also aid in controlling dust emissions from exposed areas.

stories.title: Fairfield Home Listed For Sale: Mowry-Housley couple asks $2.69 million; Napa Valley farm dream drives move
stories.summary: Tamera Mowry-Housley and Adam Housley are making waves in real estate as they list their picturesque Fairfield, California home for $2.69 million. Having acquired a quaint Napa Valley estate that requires renovations, their vision focuses on sustainable living with an orchard and vineyard to nurture their children's outdoor adventures. This shift marks a profound transformation in their family lifestyle, moving from spacious interiors to embracing more land and nature.

stories.title: 1923 Hollywood villa linked to Valentino sells for $2.5M
stories.summary: The Hollywood home at 6823 Iris Circle sold for $2.5 million, exceeding its asking price by $205,000. Initially bought for $1.05 million in 2016, the house underwent extensive renovations highlighting its history and charm. The property, linked to Rudolph Valentino and Pola Negri, boasts original features alongside modern updates. Located in Whitley Heights, a historic district, the neighborhood is known for its celebrity inhabitants.

stories.title: Third-grader Kailyn Brown won $25,000 for her child-friendly injection patches
San Antonio Park Deal: City uses $10 million buy to stop 3,500 homes; plan shields Edwards Aquifer
stories.summary: In June 2016, San Antonio city officials approved the acquisition of 204 acres of the Classen-Steubing Ranch. This initiative aims to preserve the land essential for the Edwards Aquifer recharge zone. The planned park space balances conservation with recreational facilities like sports fields and trails. Acquisition funding primarily derives from Texas's voter-approved Edwards Aquifer protection program and city budgets.

stories.title: Delhi high court cites national security, junks CIC order to IAF on PMs’ foreign trips
stories.summary: Allowing a petition by the Central Public Information Officer of Directorate of Personal Services, Air Headquarters, Justice Amit Mahajan held the IAF was justified in denying access to the records under section 8 of RTI that exempts disclosure of information that could jeopardise national security or pose a risk to a person’s life and physical safety.

stories.title: India & United States to boost defence, energy ties, Marco Rubio says trade deal close
stories.summary: Rubio’s second visit to India comes against the backdrop of the US’s Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, which is intended to penalise countries purchasing Russian oil, and Trump’s subsequent temporary suspension of related tariffs. India maintains that its oil procurement is essential not only for its own energy security but also for the stability of global markets. Rubio lauded the “substantial progress” made by India in diversifying its energy portfolio.

stories.title: Police lens on Lawrence Bishnoi’s aide Randeep Malik in Tiger Shroff shooting case
stories.summary: Anil Pandit Pandit and Shroff ’s shooter Rehan both reported to Malik and were considered “his men” till a few months ago, a source said. Rehan had been earlier tasked by Malik and Pandit with a shooting incident in Sonipat as well. “Rehan was shown the same ‘American dream’ that Malik had shown Pandit in the past,” a source said.

stories.title: Allahabad HC cites long trial, lets off offenders, SC slams ‘misplaced sympathy’
stories.summary: A bench of Justices J B Pardiwala and K Vinod Chandran said it was a case of misplaced sympathy. The trial court had awarded fiveyear jail terms to the two, but the HC released them on probation. SC said the case was “doomed from its inception insofar as justice delivery to the victim is concerned”.

stories.title: India, US ‘perfectly aligned’ on key issues: Marco Rubio; defends ties with Pakistan
stories.summary: Addressing a gathering of India Inc’s leading business figures, Rubio said the relationship between the two countries could help shape the future of the global economy, particularly as advances in artificial intelligence and quantum computing transform industries and societies. “I truly believe the relationship between US and India is defining, in many ways, in a positive way, what the 21st century can look like,” he said.

stories.title: In talks with Reliance to refine more Venezuelan oil: US secretary of state Marco Rubio
stories.summary: US secretary of state Marco Rubio is visiting Jamnagar Wednesday to tour the Reliance refinery and, in a lastminute change of schedule, is likely to spend the night there. He was earlier scheduled to leave around 9pm and return to Mumbai. In Jamnagar, he will have dinner with Mukesh Ambani at the Vantara centre. Rubio’s visit to Jamnagar comes within weeks of a vicious attack on Ambani by Elon Musk.

stories.title: Steve Buscemi returned to firefighting after 9/11 and backed a charity for his former colleagues
stories.summary: Steve Buscemi, who once served in the New York City Fire Department, stepped up to assist at Ground Zero in the wake of 9/11. This selfless act highlighted the emotional toll on first responders. He subsequently became involved with Friends of Firefighters, a nonprofit that offers crucial mental health support, not just for firefighters but also their families, ensuring privacy.

stories.title: ‘Identify and defeat forces against India’: PM Modi calls for unity during Vijayadashami celebrations
stories.summary: Drawing lessons from Lord Ram’s life, PM Modi stressed self-reliance. Despite the ocean separating him from Lanka, Lord Ram mobilised collective strength, brought together available resources and achieved what appeared impossible, he said. “We must not sit relying on others. We must recognise our own strength and we must have faith in our own resources,” the PM said, linking the message to the goals of ‘Atmanirbhar Bharat’ and ‘Viksit Bharat’.

stories.title: Indian-origin Uber driver father in NYC seeks help on GoFundMe for daughter's funeral after mother kills five-year-old: 'I lost my whole world'
A DB Cooper ransom bill found in 1980 sold for $134,200 at auction in 2026
stories.summary: A fragment of a D.B. Cooper hijacking banknote fetched an impressive $134,200 at a Dallas auction. This particular note was part of the $200,000 ransom paid to the infamous hijacker back in 1971. Interestingly, in 1980, a young boy came across a piece of this ransom money at Tena Bar, which was later confirmed as authentic by the FBI.

stories.title: 'As a second-generation Indian-American': 21-year-old Vasant Bhatt says he voted for Democrat Talarico in Texas election after being disgusted by MAGA racism
County Weighs Land Purchase: Sarasota County rejects 126-home deal; eyes conservation buy
stories.summary: In a unanimous decision, Sarasota County officials have turned down a settlement allowing residential development next to the Celery Fields. Instead, they are considering acquiring the 51-acre contested land for conservation. Following a lengthy legal dispute with D.R. Horton, the county sees this move as vital for improving stormwater management and protecting local wildlife habitats. However, the details of negotiations and funding remain unresolved, leaving the property’s future in limbo.

stories.title: Catherine Breed completes 900-mile California coast swim after 111 days
Vivek Ramaswamy called 'pathetic' after mother of his rival makes strange appeal: 'Don't vote for my daughter, she's a liar'
AAIB chief gets a year's extension as many key probes, including AI 171, on
stories.summary: People in the know say while the aviation ministry “keeps the aircraft accident investigating agency at an arm’s length and does not interfere in its working in any way,” it is taking steps to strengthen the AAIB. The bureau's lab has been recently upgraded and it now has the capability to download cockpit voice recorder and digital flight data recorder (black box) to know the conversation in the flight deck and the flight parameters till before an event being investigated.

stories.title: Two Andaman, one Chhattisgarh site added to Unesco World Heritage tentative list
stories.summary: India has added three sites to its tentative list for UNESCO World Heritage status, including the Karst-mud-volcano Complex. The sites are located in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Chhattisgarh, and the Archaeological Survey of India played a crucial role. Inclusion on this list is necessary for future nominations to the UNESCO World Heritage List. Currently, India possesses 45 UNESCO World Heritage Sites, ranking sixth in the world.

stories.title: Florida appeals court rejects homeowners’ legal fee claim after Hurricane Ian insurance dispute
stories.summary: In a recent decision, a Florida appeals court determined that homeowners Susan Reed and Kent Lonngren are ineligible to collect legal fees from Citizens Property Insurance. The couple had contested repairs linked to Hurricane Ian's 2022 storm damage. The court concluded that Citizens had fulfilled its duties, even while the homeowners pursued legal action during the appraisal phase, indicating that Citizens acted in good faith throughout the claim.

stories.title: Beverly Hills mansion once owned by Warner Bros. co-founder Harry Warner finally sells for $27.25 million
stories.summary: A legendary mansion in Beverly Hills, originally built for Harry Warner, has changed hands for $27.25 million after an extended listing. Initially priced at nearly $40 million in 2016, the estate received extensive upgrades while maintaining its Old Hollywood charm. Featuring a guesthouse linked to Marilyn Monroe, this property has hosted myriad celebrations.

stories.title: Shinde calls INDIA bloc ‘ten-headed Ravana’, accuses Uddhav of ‘vote theft’
Green Card jobs: Food delivery company Instacart agrees to pay $5 million penalty for discriminating against Americans
stories.summary: Instacart Green Card Jobs: Department of Justice said its investigation revealed that Instacart asked US workers to physically mail their applications for PER jobs while for visa holders, electronic applications were accepted. DOJ concluded that it was a discrimination against US workers and creating a burden on them.

stories.title: California’s Irvine Lake will be drained for five years as crews repair its 93-year-old dam
stories.summary: This month, Irvine Lake will see a significant decrease in water levels as vital dam repairs begin. The planned drawdown will facilitate crucial construction activities, enhancing the dam's structural integrity as per regulatory requirements. Water managers are closely monitoring potential winter weather effects to ensure community safety, while conversations with environmental specialists are underway to safely relocate fish and address concerns from anglers.

stories.title: NC State researchers create laser antenna that boosts reception 2.5 times
Wall Street climbs as healthcare stocks hit record, oil prices ease
stories.summary: Wall Street's primary indices saw an uptick, primarily driven by healthcare stocks reaching all-time highs amid falling oil prices. Investors are scrutinizing corporate earnings, with increasing worries about artificial intelligence expenditure impacting market stability. Significant advances from companies like Eli Lilly and Equifax boosted overall market performance. Nevertheless, General Motors and Steel Dynamics struggled with elevated costs and missed profit expectations.

stories.title: Indian-origin lab owner charged in US over $66.2 million bogus Covid test claims: DOJ
Delhi BJP leader burns giant cockroach effigy; CJP founder responds with SRK’s 'Swades' song
stories.summary: During Dussehra celebrations in Delhi, a 30-foot cockroach effigy was burned alongside traditional effigies of Ravan. Organizers stated that the effigy symbolized filth and promoted cleanliness in line with health awareness initiatives. Leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party reacted sharply, suggesting the move provided them with free publicity. Delhi minister Kapil Mishra remarked that cockroaches symbolize chaos and filth, reflecting public sentiment.

stories.title: No double standards on terror, need unified action to dismantle its entire ecosystem: Rajnath at SCO
Danish man transforms suburban home into castle with towers and four-metre moat
Forgotten Victorian camera found in Oxfordshire loft sells for £18,000 for wildlife conservation
stories.summary: During a house clearance in Oxfordshire, a homeowner discovered a rare Victorian camera stored for nearly 30 years. The camera, made of mahogany and brass, was auctioned for £18,000 after receiving significant interest from collectors. Proceeds from the sale will be donated to wildlife conservation charities in memory of the seller's late father. The father was passionate about nature and photographed local wildlife during his lifetime.

stories.title: Mary Berry’s daughter Belles Berry’s £3.95 million Blenheim Farm mansion goes under offer
stories.summary: Mary Berry’s daughter, Belles Berry, has received an offer for her £3.95 million Oxfordshire mansion, Blenheim Farm. Built in 2020, the property spans 10 acres and offers over 4,000 sq ft of living space. The luxury estate features a swimming pool, tennis court, two kitchens, a games room and panoramic countryside views.

stories.title: 'Expect partners to show zero tolerance on terrorism': EAM thanks US for handing over Tahawwur Rana
'Enough drama': Prince Harry says he wants to reconcile with family after years of rift
stories.summary: Prince Harry recently opened up about the need for reconciliation with his family, sharing his personal experiences that resonate with many who struggle with familial conflicts. He conveyed his aspirations for nurturing better connections with his father, King Charles III, and brother, Prince William. Harry also reflected on the joyous moments of his children attending a British school, honoring his mother's legacy and embracing a new chapter of healing.

stories.title: 'Youth on streets are revolutionaries': Uddhav Thackeray calls for 'regime change'
stories.summary: During the vibrant Dussehra rally at Shivaji Park in Mumbai, Uddhav Thackeray rallied his supporters, highlighting the significance of youth activism in addressing the alleged electoral irregularities impacting the fresh electorate. He proclaimed that the saffron identity is a legacy of his party, urging a reformation in the political climate and the prominent display of the saffron flag, echoing the influence of Bal Thackeray in his passionate address.

stories.title: Former MIT scientist wins $6 million in sexual misconduct suit by younger female colleague, says predator tag damaged career while it was a consensual relationship
Trump admin revoked more than 300,000 visas since 2025, including 4,000 linked to birth tourism: Report
Identify, defeat forces against India: Modi calls for unity, self-reliance
stories.summary: PM urges parties, institutions to put nation first; says national self-respect and strength key to overcoming challenges

stories.title: Caretaker’s 22-year stay sparks ownership battle over Frederick McCubbin’s former home
stories.summary: Fontainebleau, a former residence of the renowned artist Frederick McCubbin, finds itself at the center of a contentious legal battle over its ownership. This neglected property is co-owned by five individuals, while Trevor Hoare, the caretaker for the past 22 years, seeks to claim adverse possession. With the Supreme Court mandating a site inspection due to significant deterioration, the case is poised for its next hearing in August 2026.

stories.title: Italian banker was 'dropped to his death by mistake' when thugs dangled him out of his office window 'only to threaten'
PM Modi invokes 'Ram Rajya', warns against people hurting India's image - top quotes from Dussehra event
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Dussehra celebrations and highlighted the importance of public welfare. He emphasized the need for social justice and self-reliance as central to national development. Modi reminded attendees of the ideals of Lord Ram, focusing on justice and equal opportunities. He encouraged recognizing India's potential while serving the poor and marginalized. The Prime Minister referenced Vijayadashami as a celebration of the triumph of good over evil.

stories.title: Indian-origin couple sentenced in UK for Covid PPE fraud; millions spent on luxuries
stories.summary: Jogesh Bhandari was handed a sentence for deceiving companies with false promises of supplying personal protective equipment during the COVID-19 pandemic. His conning tactics included misappropriating payments meant for PPE to fund a luxurious lifestyle. In a related verdict, his wife, Meenakshi Bhandari, received a suspended sentence alongside community service due to her participation.

stories.title: Florida couple missed 66 mortgage payments; husband's legal challenge fails after 17 years
stories.summary: A Florida couple missed 66 monthly mortgage payments on their Naples property, triggering a foreclosure dispute that began in 2009. During the legal battle, Gregory Brian Myers agreed to deposit $5,000 monthly while appealing the foreclosure. He later sued U.S. Bank, alleging it had violated their agreement. On October 19, 2026, a federal appeals court upheld the dismissal of his lawsuit.

stories.title: Evening news wrap: Rubio calls India a refining superpower; Kharge to raise SIR, delimitation concerns with PM Modi & more
‘Doing a real disservice’: Annamalai backs CJP leaders, questions their continued custody
Air India Express flight suffers bird strike, lands safely in Bengaluru
stories.summary: An Air India Express flight en route from Bhogapuram to Bengaluru encountered a bird strike on Monday, yet all 148 passengers and crew emerged safely. Following the event, technical teams diligently inspected the aircraft, confirming it was in good condition for future flights. Notably, a comparable bird strike event affected an Emirates flight just days earlier on October 17.

stories.title: 65-year old swimmer killed in shark attack off South African coast; 2 beaches shut
stories.summary: Tragedy struck at Orient Beach in KuGompo City when 65-year-old open-water swimmer Janine Lochrenberg was fatally attacked by a shark. Despite the desperate efforts of fellow swimmers who rushed to assist her, she suffered life-threatening injuries to her arm and thigh, ultimately succumbing to her wounds. In response, local authorities promptly closed the beach and launched an investigation, as reports indicate a slight rise in shark attacks in recent years.

stories.title: Daniel Rotman built PrettyLitter into a brand valued at $1.4 billion before Mars’ buyout
'Nobody told me..that's very confusing': Indian man Kamlesh Shah charged with election fraud in US says he didn't know he was not supposed to vote
Georgia woman’s deed to stepson rescinded; appeals court upholds $57,600 award
stories.summary: In a complex property dispute, a woman in Georgia transferred her property interest to her stepson during a period of cognitive decline. Her guardian, suspecting exploitation and fraud, pursued legal action, leading to a jury decision that invalidated the transfer and awarded damages. The stepson contested this ruling, alleging jury misconduct. However, the appeals court decided to uphold the initial verdict, solidifying the guardian's victory.

stories.title: Keith Haring’s hidden 1979 mural resurfaces in a $25M New York loft
Barbara Hutton’s Rolls-Royce survived a prince’s fatal crash and sold for £166,750 in 2026
stories.summary: This remarkable 1933 Rolls-Royce Phantom II Continental was originally crafted as a luxurious present from Barbara Hutton to Prince Alexis Mdivani. Following a tragic accident that claimed the prince's life, the exquisite vehicle was returned to Hutton for repairs. It changed hands multiple times before making its way to the United States in the 1970s.

stories.title: After Sergey Brin divorce, Nicole Shanahan's former Malibu home rents for $175,000 a month
Australian lawmaker Helen Haines loses leg after being hit twice by car: Report
stories.summary: Independent lawmaker Helen Haines was gravely injured when a man reportedly collided with her vehicle. This alarming event unfolded outside her office in Wangaratta, Victoria, as she was loading items from her car. Eyewitnesses claim the driver intentionally hit her car twice before escaping. A brave bystander managed to restrain the driver until the police arrived and took him into custody.

stories.title: 1867 gold coin found in Texas closet sells for $97,600 after 159 years in a family’s possession
stories.summary: A remarkable 1867-S Liberty Half Eagle gold coin was unearthed from an obscure closet in Texas, boasting a staggering value of $97,600. This highly sought-after coin, a valuable heirloom of a Union soldier, shattered previous auction records. Experts praised its rarity and condition, sparking intense competition among collectors. After a thrilling auction, the coin found its new home in a private collection, bringing its extraordinary journey to a close.

stories.title: Amit Shah meets families of anti-drug campaigners killed in Punjab; targets AAP on open drug trade
stories.summary: Amit Shah visited families of drug-related victims in Punjab, expressing condolences and discussing safety issues. He criticised the AAP government for its failure to tackle the drug menace effectively. Shah highlighted the dangers faced by those who oppose drug trafficking in the state. The recent murder of anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota escalated political tensions in Punjab.

stories.title: Qing dynasty bowl with bats and peaches sells for $2.048 million after 87 years in a Chicago museum
stories.summary: A stunning porcelain bowl from the Qing dynasty recently fetched $2.048 million at a Christie's auction. Crafted during Emperor Yongzheng's reign, the bowl is adorned with auspicious symbols, hinting it was a birthday gift for the emperor. After decades in the Art Institute of Chicago, the proceeds will fund new acquisitions and conservation efforts. This sale is part of a lucrative two-day auction dedicated to Chinese art.

stories.title: UK football club boss faces £100k legal battle over 24ft garden room built in 2018
stories.summary: A UK football club official is facing a court battle with his upstairs neighbour over a 24ft garden room built in 2018 with a bar, television and electric doorbell. Justin Salmon altered the structure after a tribunal found it breached his lease, but neighbour Andrianna Neophytou says the changes are insufficient and wants it demolished. Legal costs could exceed £100,000.

stories.title: Toledo’s 1897 swing bridge gets $65M upgrade to carry 286,000-pound railcars
stories.summary: In 2029, a comprehensive renovation of the Toledo Swing Bridge is set to begin, aimed at boosting freight operations. Key structural enhancements will enable the bridge to support heavier railcars, thereby improving efficiency in transportation. The project, backed by substantial federal funding alongside contributions from Wheeling & Lake Erie Railway, underscores a dedication to bettering rail infrastructure and strengthening ties with local port facilities.

stories.title: ‘Felt very happy’: Annamalai welcomes Bhagwat's remarks on Muslims' place in India
stories.summary: K Annamalai lauded Mohan Bhagwat's recent statements on the significance of religious inclusivity in India. Speaking at a Faith Leaders Conference in New York, Bhagwat encouraged the embrace of diverse communities, including Muslims, reiterating the value of dignity for all. Annamalai pointed out the rising global fascination with Indian civilization, stressing the necessity for leaders and citizens to embody the nation's established ideals.

stories.title: ‘Deeply regrettable’: Sanjay Raut’s Albania arson post draws flak from party colleague, others
BJP’s delimitation gambit: Will it isolate Congress, puncture opposition’s SIR unity?
stories.summary: As the government gears up for a new delimitation effort, Congress’s quest for opposition unity faces hurdles. Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge raised alarms about the government's legislative strategies pertaining to delimitation and reservations for women. With Kiren Rijiju hinting at discussions across various opposition factions that may favor the bills, the scenario presents a complex web of political dynamics.
