Submerged Archaeological Sites Study: Researchers map two underwater Aboriginal sites; stone moved 23 km
stories.summary: Archaeologists collaborated with Indigenous rangers to explore submerged sites off Murujuga in Western Australia. They uncovered artefacts and evidence of past human activity before rising sea levels altered the landscape. Two key locations highlighted interactions with freshwater resources and elevated terrains. The research involved several universities and emphasized the importance of Indigenous expertise in cultural heritage.

stories.title: Miami teen becomes ‘Spider-Man of Brickell’ after brave chase
stories.summary: Harry Cossyphas, a Miami high school senior, became a local hero after chasing a theft suspect. He witnessed a robbery and immediately pursued the man into an alley, despite being pepper-sprayed. Cossyphas managed to tackle the suspect and hold him until the police arrived. The Miami Police honored him with a hero award and acknowledged his bravery and prompt response. The suspect, Yagiz Dogan, was charged with third-degree grand theft.

stories.title: Edinburgh's historic Palm Houses reopen after a £23.5m restoration replaced 5,750 panes of glass
stories.summary: The Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh's Palm Houses have undergone extensive restorations costing £23.5 million over the past five years. Researchers carefully replaced all 5,750 glass panes to ensure they withstand harsh weather conditions. Following this work, nearly 600 rare plant specimens have been replanted in the glasshouses. The restoration enables continued conservation, education, and scientific discovery efforts related to endangered flora.

stories.title: Texas courthouse vacant since 1977 faces demolition after $120 million repair estimates
stories.summary: In a decisive move, Nueces County officials have voted unanimously to proceed with the demolition of the aged 1914 courthouse, which has seen a decline over the decades and thwarted multiple redevelopment attempts. Expected to last around 130 days, the demolition aims to create opportunities for future development while eliminating continuous security expenses for taxpayers. While some historical artifacts will be saved, extensive asbestos contamination complicates the safe removal process.

stories.title: Doe House Listed At $27 Million: 1908 Pacific Heights mansion hits market; bay views meet modern luxury
stories.summary: Built in 1908 for timber magnate Frank P. Doe, Doe House merges historic charm with modern amenities. Spanning 8,175 square feet, it boasts seven spacious bedrooms and ample outdoor spaces. Nestled in Pacific Heights, the mansion offers breathtaking views of Lafayette Park and San Francisco Bay. With its recent renovations that preserve the original Edwardsian style, this $27 million estate is a remarkable find for discerning buyers.

stories.title: Historic Inn Becomes Commons: Community restores 1901 landmark; raised to cut flooding risk
stories.summary: The former Island Inn on Ocracoke Island has been reborn as a vibrant community and cultural hub, thanks to the passionate efforts of local residents and the Ocracoke Preservation Society. Faced with the threat of redevelopment, they successfully restored the historic building, which now hosts a variety of educational programs and community gatherings. Key renovations improved its safety and flood resilience.

stories.title: Natalie Harp printed out Susie Wiles' ouster speculation report; Trump 'blew up' leading to White House 'freakout'
Two vessels carrying 24 Indian seafarers hit by projectiles, drone in separate incidents; all safe
stories.summary: Union shipping minister Sarbananda Sonowal confirmed that two vessels carrying Indian seafarers were attacked in October. The MT ST 3 was struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, while the YARA J was hit by a drone off Romania. Fortunately, all 24 Indian nationals aboard both vessels are reported safe and unharmed. India has condemned attacks on commercial vessels, citing concerns for the safety of seafarers.

stories.title: 'American workers should come first in their own country': Republicans bring new bill to make H-1B visa salary threshold $140,000
‘Don’t have to do this’: Trump tells new press secy Zacharia she can quit if she wants
stories.summary: Katie Zacharia has faced significant scrutiny after her brief tenure as White House press secretary. Donald Trump expressed concerns about the job's challenges and suggested she reconsider her position. The media has provided harsh coverage of her professional background and recent press briefing. Despite his doubts, Trump emphasized that the decision about her future is ultimately up to her.

stories.title: Russia strikes 9 Ukrainian regions as new report shows spike in civilian casualties
stories.summary: Russia's recent strikes have plunged Ukraine into darkness, impacting electricity for hundreds of thousands and resulting in civilian injuries. Amidst this turmoil, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy voiced his worries over diminishing US support during a summit in Brussels. Civilian casualties surged by 85% in September compared to last year, as Ukraine urgently calls for more military aid while the EU seeks to enhance its support for the beleaguered nation.

stories.title: US tells election officials to guard against AI-powered cyber threats ahead of midterm elections
Israeli settlers attack Palestinian villages, torch cars and trees during olive harvest
stories.summary: Residents and human rights organisations say Israeli authorities have done little to stop settler attacks. They allege that soldiers have sometimes helped settlers, protected them or stood by while Palestinian villages came under assault. The violence has prompted accusations of “ethnic cleansing”, including from the British government, which accused Israel of turning a “blind eye” to the campaign.

Off-duty US soldier saves gunshot victim, earns Army Commendation Medal for quick first aid
stories.summary: When gunfire erupted near his residence, Private First Class Stephen Bradley sprang into action, showcasing his military training to help a gunshot victim. His quick thinking involved applying a tourniquet and pressure dressing, stabilizing the civilian's injuries until emergency responders arrived. Local authorities are actively investigating the shooting, while Bradley's bravery earned him the Army Commendation Medal for his commendable response during this critical situation.

stories.title: NCW steps in after video shows senior J&K IAS officer 'abusing' woman subordinate
India diversified crude oil sources from 27 to 41 amid disruptions in Hormuz, Red Sea: Hardeep Puri
stories.summary: India has expanded its crude oil supply sources from 27 to 41 countries to improve energy security. The government is also increasing its refining capacity and exploring new oil sources in response to geopolitical concerns. Minister Hardeep Singh Puri emphasized the impact of global shipping disruptions on domestic industries and households. He outlined plans to enhance domestic energy production through initiatives like the Samudra Manthan scheme.
